# Code map

Every assembly, source file and type, with the first sentence of each type's XML summary.
Regenerated at session start (SessionStart hook) and by `/wrap-up`. A "(no summary)" type needs one.

## Statecraft.Editor

`Assets/Scripts/Editor`, Editor only. References: Statecraft.Sim, Statecraft.Game, Statecraft.UI, Unity.InputSystem, UnityEngine.UI.

- `MainSceneBuilder.cs`: `MainSceneBuilder` (class): Builds Assets/Scenes/Main.unity from code, plus the assets it needs (panel settings, the placeholder marker material).
- `ProjectSetup.cs`: `ProjectSetup` (class): Player settings for a mobile-first project, applied from code so they are reviewable in git.

## Statecraft.Game

`Assets/Scripts/Game`. References: Statecraft.Sim.

- `GameRoot.cs`: `GameRoot` (class): Composition root: builds the simulation for the starting scenario and hands it to the SimulationHost.
- `SimulationHost.cs`: `SimulationHost` (class): Runs the simulation in real time with pause: turns unscaled frame time into whole monthly ticks at the chosen speed.
- `WorldView.cs`: `WorldView` (class): Placeholder map: one primitive cylinder per nation on a ring.

## Statecraft.Sim

`Assets/Scripts/Sim`, pure C# (noEngineReferences). References: none.

- `AssemblyInfo.cs`: (no types)
- `Commands/CallVote.cs`: `CallVote` (class): The hidden hand calls a vote on the government type; only types that can vote (Democracy) allow it.

- `Commands/SetMediaMix.cs`: `SetMediaMix` (class): Sets a nation's airtime mix from eight weights: the seven vices in order, then neutral programming.
- `Core/Defeat.cs`: `Defeat` (enum): How the player's home nation was lost (D-0019), or None while the game goes on.
- `Core/EventLog.cs`: `EventLog` (class): Bounded history of recent SimEvents plus a running total, so views can poll for what is new since they last looked without subscribing mid-tick.
- `Core/SimCommand.cs`: `SimCommand` (class): An instruction to change a lever.
- `Core/SimContext.cs`: `SimContext` (class): Everything a system needs during one tick.
- `Core/SimDate.cs`: `SimDate` (struct): A position on the game calendar.
- `Core/SimEvent.cs`: `SimEvent` (struct): A notable change the simulation reports outward (events out, commands in).

- `Core/SimMath.cs`: `SimMath` (class): Numeric helpers shared by every system.

## Statecraft.Sim.Tests

`Assets/Tests/Sim`, Editor only. References: Statecraft.Sim, UnityEngine.TestRunner, UnityEditor.TestRunner.

- `BalanceTests.cs`: `BalanceTests` (class): Balance targets for suspicion and the hand's survival (MODEL.md, "Balance targets", 2026-10-15).
- `EconomyTests.cs`: `EconomyTests` (class): The economy and population (D-0036): land, labor, food, goods, wealth, births, deaths and starvation.
- `InstitutionTests.cs`: `InstitutionTests` (class): Lever data: shares normalize, media push is measured from an even mix, severity clamps.
- `LedgerTests.cs`: `LedgerTests` (class): The "why?" ledger must account for every computed value exactly, or explanations lie.
- `PoliticsTests.cs`: `PoliticsTests` (class): Executable statements of the politics design (D-0019 to D-0024, D-0032): alignment, two-tier suspicion, the government as a shield, revolutions, votes, generational revolts and defeat.
- `RiverBehaviorTests.cs`: `RiverBehaviorTests` (class): Executable statements of the design (Docs/design, Docs/simulation/MODEL.md).
- `ScenarioTests.cs`: `ScenarioTests` (class): Built-in scenarios must keep the personalities they were written to have.
- `SimDateTests.cs`: `SimDateTests` (class): Calendar math: ticks map to years and months.
- `SimRandomTests.cs`: `SimRandomTests` (class): The PCG32 generator matches the reference output, repeats from a seed, and restores from saved state.
- `SimulationTests.cs`: `SimulationTests` (class): Engine guarantees: determinism, bounded values, a quiet start, and command timing.
- `TestWorlds.cs`: `TestWorlds` (class): Builders for small test worlds.
- `ViceVectorTests.cs`: `ViceVectorTests` (class): Indexing and component-wise math on the seven-vice vector.

## Statecraft.UI

`Assets/Scripts/UI`. References: Statecraft.Sim, Statecraft.Game.

- `DevHud.cs`
  - `DevHud` (class): Developer HUD, not the player UI: date and speed, the selected nation's levers, its vice table, generations, economy and outcomes, a "why" breakdown from the ledger, and recent events.
  - `LeverTab` (nested enum): Which lever group the left panel shows.
  - `Meter` (nested class): One labeled bar in the outcomes section.
- `SafeAreaPadding.cs`: `SafeAreaPadding` (class): Pads a full-screen UI Toolkit element so content avoids notches and rounded corners (Screen.safeArea).

## Statecraft.SimRunner

`Tools/Headless/Runner`, headless console tool (not in the game). References: Statecraft.Sim.

- `DocsCommand.cs`
  - `DocsCommand` (class): The "docs" command: writes the docs that are derived from the live model, so they cannot drift from it.
  - `EdgeStats` (nested class): Running statistics for one source-to-target edge across every run.
- `LeverScripts.cs`
  - `LeverScripts` (class): Named, scripted player behavior for headless experiments: which levers the hidden hand pulls in its home nation, and in which year.
  - `Script` (nested class): A named script and what it changes at the start of each simulated year.
- `Options.cs`: `Options` (class): Minimal "--key value" argument parser; a bare "--flag" reads as "true".
- `Program.cs`: `Program` (class): Command-line entry for headless runs of the pure C# simulation (balancing experiments) and for the docs generated from the live model (parameters table, causal graph).
- `RunCommand.cs`: `RunCommand` (class): The "run" command: one scripted game, printed as a yearly table, optionally as CSV.
- `SweepCommand.cs`
  - `SweepCommand` (class): The "sweep" command: pushes one lever of the home nation to an extreme at a time and reports how far each outcome moved at that lever's own horizon (media 1 year, courts 1 year, schools 25 years), ...
  - `Probe` (nested class): (no summary)
- `XmlDocs.cs`: `XmlDocs` (class): Reads Statecraft.Sim.xml (the compiler's XML documentation output) so generated docs quote the code's own summaries instead of restating them.

## Tooling scripts

- `Tools/docs/doctool.py`: Statecraft Simulator documentation tool: hooks, skills and the doc linter call this (stdlib only, Python 3.10+).
- `Tools/unity.ps1`: Runs Unity in batch mode for this project: compile check, edit-mode tests, or project setup.
- `Tools/verify.ps1`: Checks the whole project: headless build and tests, doc lint, and optionally Unity tests and regenerated docs.
